Plot event studies and sensitivity confidence sets

Source: R/plot.R
plot_cohort.Rd

ATT results are plotted against the sensitivity bound. Dynamic and cohort-dynamic results overlay robust sets on conventional event-study coefficients. Multiple bounds are faceted. All intervals are pointwise. Disconnected confidence-set components are drawn separately; unbounded endpoints use arrows. Numerical failures are reported, not drawn as sets.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cohort_fit'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("dynamic", "cohort-dynamic"),
  cohorts = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = "Effect",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'cohort_sensitivity'
plot(
  x,
  M = NULL,
  cohorts = NULL,
  identified.set = TRUE,
  main = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = "Effect",
  color = NULL,
  type = c("sets", "weights"),
  weights = c("coefficients", "gamma"),
  by = c("element", "cohort"),
  targets = NULL,
  labels = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A cohort_fit or cohort_sensitivity object.

type

For fits, an aggregated ("dynamic") or cohort-specific ("cohort-dynamic") event study. For sensitivity results, "sets" (default) plots the confidence sets and "weights" the FLCI weights.

cohorts

Optional subset of integer cohort adoption indices. With type = "weights", it selects the rows of these cohorts.

main

Optional plot title.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

...

Reserved for additional graphical arguments.

M

Optional subset of computed bounds to plot.

identified.set

Show the plug-in identified-set band for ATT plots? Only for type = "sets".

color

Optional sensitivity-set color, overriding the paper palette. Only for type = "sets".

weights

With type = "weights": "coefficients" (default) or "gamma", as in flci_weights.

by

With type = "weights": "element" (default) or "cohort", as in flci_weights.

targets

With type = "weights": optional target ids, as in x$intervals$target; by default every target, one panel each.

labels

With type = "weights": print the values in the cells?

Value

An editable ggplot object. With type = "weights", NULL (invisibly) when there is nothing to draw.

Details

With type = "weights", an FLCI result is drawn as a heatmap of flci_weights(x, weights, by): one row per pre-treatment coefficient or second difference (labelled by relative period, grouped by cohort, earliest at the top) or per cohort, one column per computed bound, and one panel per target. Negative values are blue, positive values vermilion, and zeros white. M, cohorts and targets select bounds, rows and panels; identified.set and color apply only to type = "sets". For a post-only FLCI, gamma is zero by construction, and weights = "gamma" only prints a message. Conditional and C-LF results have no such weights.
